assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background image for the start screen of RECLAIM, a PC survival action game. Create a completely new wide 16:9 cinematic illustration, 1920x1080 or greater. Scene: Tokyo devastated by an artificial intelligence revolt, abandoned streets with collapsed concrete midrise buildings, fractured elevated rail structure, a few recognizably Japanese urban shapes and distant Tokyo Tower; rubble, abandoned vehicles, small sparse vines, cold dirty blue-gray twilight and subdued dusty amber light. Fortnite early Chapter 1 inspired art direction: sculpted large readable shapes, hand-painted material treatment, sophisticated stylized 3D videogame environment, NOT photoreal photography, NOT anime illustration. Camera at street height looking along a broad ruined avenue toward the skyline. The entire environment must remain legible, richly detailed, cinematic and atmospheric, not muddy or all black. Foreground lower corners have broken concrete slabs and wreckage forming dark natural occluders. Fog drifts through middle ground, but leave enough crisp environment detail for depth. Critical narrative detail: a truly colossal final-boss AI collective almost invisible far beyond the skyline, a kilometer-scale irregular congregation of dark machine structures and skeletal forms, so enormous only its faint upper silhouette is discernible behind several layers of atmospheric mist; it must take a moment to notice. No clear robot face, no bright red eyes, no giant obvious character. Reserve the left 40 percent around the upper-middle and middle for independently composited game title and menu: dark quiet open sky and subdued distant building shapes, no large foreground object cutting through this area. Visual focal point and skyline depth mostly center/right. No human, no friendly or player character, no foreground monsters, no title lettering, no logos, no buttons, no UI, no borders, no watermark. Painted background only, animated enemy elements will be separate transparent layers.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent PNG game sprite for a lightweight layered game title screen. Subject: one small hostile AI surveillance drone, angular battered dark charcoal armor, broad compact asymmetric wedge silhouette, two short swept side pods, very small dim amber sensor slit; no friendly cues. Viewed three-quarter from below, pointing slightly to the left, isolated fully on transparent background. Early Fortnite Chapter 1 inspired sculpted readable 3D game asset aesthetic, handpainted materials, understated cool twilight lighting, restrained amber reflection. Keep shape simple, believable and threatening in a ruined Tokyo setting. Full drone visible with generous transparent padding, object occupying about 65% of canvas width. Single drone only. No scenery, no ground, no fog, no text, no logo, no UI, no border, no drop shadow plane. Actually transparent alpha background, clean feather-free edges. This sprite will appear at tiny scale partly concealed by mist, so prioritize silhouette.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent PNG enemy sprite for a layered game title screen. Subject: a distant humanoid hostile AI sentinel, faceless narrow head and lean long articulated armored body, battered dark graphite plate armor, subtly inhuman proportions, arms down at sides, a single tiny subdued amber chest sensor. Full body including both feet, seen three-quarter from side, facing left, standing with one foot slightly ahead in a cautious stalking pose. No handheld weapon, no hero pose, no human face, no friendly/player styling, no extra figures. Early Fortnite Chapter 1 inspired sculpted stylized 3D videogame aesthetic, broad readable silhouette, handpainted materials, cool dim twilight edge lighting. Keep the figure visually dark, intended to be small and mostly hidden among distant ruins. Isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background, no scenery, no floor plane, no fog, no shadows outside figure, no text, no logo, no UI, no border. Entire body inside canvas with transparent padding.
